name: Hive Launcher
description:
A honeycomb app launcher for GNOME Shell.

Tiles sit on a honeycomb or square lattice under a fisheye lens. Drag or scroll to pan, use only the keyboard (F1 lists every key), or just type to search. Right-click a tile for windows, favourites, details and hide. Optional folders (by category, from GNOME's app folders, or your own layout arranged by drag and drop), a centre tile that can show a clock, system load, battery or the playing track, many tile shapes, themes and presets, and optional liquid-glass tiles.

Toggle with Super+Shift+A (configurable in the preferences) or the panel icon.

Privacy: no network access and no telemetry. The extension reads your app list and settings, and system figures from /proc and /sys (load, memory, battery, pressure) to adapt its animation quality. The performance log is off by default and only writes a text file to ~/.cache/hive-launcher.
